what_happened: Discovered the merge engine already has a tested retraction primitive (M.unmerge_settings + build_retained_fragments + state.get_merged_sections) and a load-time hook-orphan-sweep precedent (task 369), both unused by the forced-reload/resync_all path. Recommending a small sequencing fix (call existing unmerge before re-merge in manager.load's force branch) instead of a new permissions-specific mechanism or a one-time migration script, since deploy-headless.sh's TARGET_REPO argument + nvim's fixed runtime config location means the single engine fix propagates to all five named repos via redeploy alone.
